description: Atos de Enquadramento no REIDI relacionados a projetos de geração e transmissão de energia elétrica. is a dataset listed in Brazilian Ministry of Mines and Energy open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministério de Minas e Energia. O conjunto de dados vinculados ao REIDI vincula-se a projetos de geração e transmissão de energia elétrica. Para mais informações sobre regulamentos e procedimentos de enquadramento, acesse:. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher Ministério de Minas e Energia. Its tags are REIDI, geração de energia elétrica, incentivo fiscal, infraestrutura energética, transmissão de energia elétrica. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-08-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Outra (Aberta). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mme-portal.
